name: Patsanskoye leto
source:
The story presents a blend of lowbrow humor and psychology with a bit of action and romance, all led by its protagonist, Semyon. A thug who loves to pick on innocent nerds. The terror of the neighborhoods, nicknamed "Syomka". The protagonist arrives at the camp as a ruffian, but one who possesses an understanding of normal life. His thuggish behavior alternates with that of a gentleman, as he prefers to behave decently around the ladies in the camp. But sometimes he just can't hold back his emotions and reveals his true "Lad from the Block" nature.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=545401420]Steam[/url]]
